verdict.rationale: Azure's own declarative deployment tools (ARM templates and Bicep) let a user state many resources and deploy them in one operation. The Azure CLI supports scripted management and JMESPath `--query` filtering, which together approximate multi-item operations. However, nothing in the evidence documents explicit bulk or batch operations such as batch APIs, bulk update/delete across selected items, or tag-based mass actions. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation documentation, batch REST endpoints, bulk modify/delete of existing items, independent or hands-on corroboration.
